revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - <:Καλλιρόῃ|reg|Κα̣λ̣ηρ̣όει:> in lin2 is probably right (I have also consulted F. Morelli, who discussed this papyrus years ago). α̣λ̣ compares well with other αλ in the text. It's a bit worrying that we need to reckon with a rare name in the papyri and with an error, but there are many errors in the papyrus. As BL 13 does not have ζυγός but ζεῦγος, add 'cf.' or even give a reference to Morelli's article. Add accents to 'irregular' forms.
Submit - Integration of BL 13 readings. New name in l. 2.

Commit - I've integrated BL 13 changes for κεράτιον, with one difference: in his article in ZPE, F. Morelli uses the form ζυγός not ζεῦγος, which appears in the BL 13. For l. 2, κληρώσει|reg|κληρόσι => BL 13.262 (κ(υρίᾳ))|alt|(κυ̣ρ̣(ίᾳ))(?) => I read Κα̣λ̣ηρ̣όει (l. Καλλιρόη).
Vote - AcceptText - See Backhuys' comments. Lin5 try using the BL mark up differently.

Vote - AcceptText - l. 3: the ed. has βυρίτιον, not βιρίτιον; otherwise OK l. 5: I would retain only the correction from BL 11 <:μύει̣ον=BL 11.289|ed|Μύσιον:>, since repeating BL 9 and 10 does not improve the understanding of the text
Submit - Updated text with multiple corrections (BL 9, 10, 11)
Automated transfer of accents across reg-orig pairs
batch converted all tei:sic to tei:orig and tei:corr to tei:reg
changed schema; added xml:space=preserve; indented; moved title/@n to idno
Converted from TEI P4 (EpiDoc DTD v. 6) to P5 (EpiDoc RNG schema)
